scope.zh: P1、P2 與 P4–P6 的本機基礎功能已實作。P3、P7 已有部分 adapter；合作夥伴驗收與完整方法重寫仍未完成。
scope.en: P1, P2 and local baseline features for P4–P6 are implemented. P3 and P7 have scoped adapters; partner acceptance and full method reimplementations remain outstanding.

reusePolicy.zh: 重寫前核對功能需求、版本及授權；原始碼再利用需逐案審查，不假設可直接沿用名稱、資料或 API。
reusePolicy.en: Check requirements, versions and licensing before implementation. Review code reuse separately; do not assume rights to names, data or APIs.

scope.zh: 補齊議題、紀錄、輪次與交接規格；保留舊版缺欄位狀態。
scope.en: Specify issue, record, round and handoff fields while preserving missing legacy context.

acceptance.zh: 新版與舊版範例可讀；錯誤欄位、來源斷鏈、秘密資訊及偽造交接均拒絕；瀏覽器與 CLI 使用同一驗證器。
acceptance.en: New and legacy fixtures pass; malformed fields, broken provenance, credentials and forged handoffs fail; browser and CLI share validation.

title.zh: 接回 Pocket Polis 的完整分析

scope.zh: 盤點最新匯出；保留分群、支持度、模型／演算法版本、覆蓋率與引文，不將摘要當原話。
scope.en: Audit current exports; retain groups, support, model/algorithm versions, coverage and quotations separately from voices.

acceptance.zh: 固定版本公開資料往返；無法保存的欄位明列；票數與來源逐筆核對。
acceptance.en: Pinned public fixtures round-trip with field-level loss reporting and checked counts and source links.

delivery.zh: 已釘選 Pocket Polis 參考版本與三組公開選集，新增分析交接頁；正式站唯讀核對 25 則陳述、2 群。未取得的服務版本保持未知。
delivery.en: Pinned Pocket Polis reference and three public subsets; added analysis handoff. Production read verified 25 statements and 2 groups. Undisclosed service versions remain unknown.

title.zh: 原版服務轉接與共同驗收

scope.zh: 先做一個指定 Decidim 實例的唯讀匯入；再與 V2V／Assemblis 夥伴對照實際檔案。
scope.en: Start with read-only import from one pinned Decidim instance, then compare actual V2V / Assemblis partner exports.

acceptance.zh: 保存多語、版本、採納狀態與來源；讀取、寫回與對方驗收分開標示。
acceptance.en: Preserve multilingual text, revisions, adoption and provenance; report read, write-back and partner acceptance separately.

delivery.zh: 已完成指定 Metadecidim 格式唯讀 adapter；版本端點為 null。V2V／Assemblis 實際檔案與共同驗收待取得。
delivery.en: Implemented a named Metadecidim read-only adapter; version endpoint returns null. Actual V2V/Assemblis files and joint acceptance remain pending.

title.zh: 意見到決策的責任追蹤

scope.zh: 深化 V2V 類型功能：採納理由、未採納原因、更正申請、責任人及期限；延伸既有工作台。
scope.en: Extend the workspace with V2V-style adoption reasons, non-adoption, correction requests, owners and deadlines.

acceptance.zh: 一筆原話可查多來源提案與正式回覆；草稿不等於承諾；更正與撤回可追溯。
acceptance.en: Trace a voice through multi-source proposals and authorized responses; drafts stay distinct from commitments, with correction and withdrawal history.

delivery.zh: 已加入更正申請、理由、期限、多來源影響與修訂歷程；沿用既有回覆責任與處置功能。
delivery.en: Added correction requests, reasons, deadlines, multi-source impact and revisions, alongside existing accountability and disposition.

scope.zh: 建立 Assemblis 類型的輕量場次工具：議程、小組、主持紀錄、會後評估及參與支持。
scope.en: Build a lightweight Assemblis-style session module: agenda, groups, facilitation notes, post-session evaluation and participation support.

acceptance.zh: 完成一場模擬混合審議；區分受邀、出席、發言、投票人數；評估不推論代表性。
acceptance.en: Run a simulated hybrid session; distinguish invited, attending, speaking and voting counts without inferring representativeness.

delivery.zh: 已加入議程、分組、線上／實體場次、分開的參與紀錄與會後回饋；為本機主持工具，非即時多人會議服務。
delivery.en: Added agendas, groups, settings, distinct participation observations and post-session feedback. A local facilitation tool, not a live conferencing service.

scope.zh: 在 Pocket Proposals／Argument 補上 Evocracy、Swarmcheck 類型的分組推進、證據與修訂工作。
scope.en: Extend Pocket Proposals / Argument with Evocracy- and Swarmcheck-style group progression, evidence and revision workflows.

acceptance.zh: 有來源的論點支持或反對可追溯；代表推進規則明確；保留少數意見。
acceptance.en: Trace sourced supporting and opposing arguments, explicit advancement rules and minority views.

delivery.zh: 已加入固定門檻、佐證、少數意見與逐階段推進；可追溯既有提案版本。尚未重寫 Evocracy 代表選拔或 Swarmcheck 完整演算法。
delivery.en: Added fixed thresholds, evidence, minority views and stage progression, linked to proposal versions. Evocracy representative selection and full Swarmcheck algorithms are not reimplemented.

title.zh: 聯邦式整合與規模化諮詢

scope.zh: 評估 Hypha 整合介面及 Make.org 資料轉接；以實際匯出/API 與授權為前提。
scope.en: Evaluate Hypha integration and Make.org adapters against actual exports/APIs and permissions.

acceptance.zh: 取得版本、授權與實際格式後才列為支援；未提供接口時維持人工交接。
acceptance.en: Claim support only after version, licensing and actual-format verification; retain manual handoff where no interface exists.

delivery.zh: 已核對 Hypha 治理實驗匯出碼並實作檔案 adapter；預設值與不穩定 ID 明示。Make.org 尚缺可用的授權測試檔／契約。
delivery.en: Inspected Hypha governance export code and implemented a file adapter with explicit placeholder and unstable-ID limits. Make.org still needs a usable authorized fixture/contract.

approach.zh: 補齊最新分析格式轉接
保持訪談者與參與者區別
approach.en: Keep interviewer and participant roles distinct

approach.zh: 保留臺灣立法情境；原版另做轉接
approach.en: Retain Taiwan legislative context; adapt originals separately

approach.zh: 按活動需求補跳題與會後評估
approach.en: Add branching and evaluation only for session needs

approach.zh: 先接原版資料，不複製整套治理平台
approach.en: Import original data before expanding proposal modules

approach.zh: 獨立實作輕量場次與品質評估
approach.en: Implement lightweight sessions and quality evaluation

approach.zh: 擴充團隊協作與代表推進
approach.en: Extend team collaboration and representative advancement

approach.zh: 擴充證據、論證及來源連結
已接固定版本 exported_data.json；尚未共同驗收
approach.en: Pinned exported_data.json adapter implemented; no joint acceptance

approach.zh: 先評估可授權轉接的資料，暫不完整重寫
approach.en: Evaluate permitted data adapters; full rewrite deferred
